status: two typography trials authorised; latest instruction requires one typeface per cover
latest_constraint: Let's avoid mixed fonts on the same page though - that didn't work too great last time.
supersedes: Previous suggestion to combine a serif title with Nunito Sans sticker and author. These trials instead use one coherent serif family throughout each cover.
interior_context: Approved Greenhouse Tomato spread and saved font rules inspected previously: Lilita One headings and Nunito Sans supporting text. These cover-only serif proposals aim for a warmer, more solid character, not an exact font match.
controls: Both trials independently use 06B Lighter sage as the sole edit reference. One serif family for all wording per trial, varying size and weight only. Chosen background colour, composition, title overlap, photo and sticker requested unchanged.

variants.name: Stronger current serif
variants.prompt:
Create a controlled TYPOGRAPHY-ONLY EDIT of the supplied book cover. Output one complete flat front cover, same portrait proportions, retaining the existing design and photograph.

CRITICAL LATEST USER REQUIREMENT: ONE COHERENT TYPEFACE THROUGHOUT THIS COVER. The title, small "The", subtitle sticker and author name must ALL use the SAME serif family. Only size and weight may vary for hierarchy. Do not mix serif and sans-serif, do not use a separate display or script family, and do not use Nunito Sans for the supporting text. Keep "The" upright in the same family. Pay particular attention to making the sticker and author visibly belong to the exact same lettering family as the headline.

DIRECTION A — A MODEST STRENGTHENING OF THE EXISTING SERIF. Keep the elegant tall proportions, fine bracketless serifs and graceful character of the current title. Give the thin strokes noticeably more substance, around 20–25% thicker, with a small increase in overall weight, reducing the extreme thick/thin contrast while remaining refined and open. Do not convert it to a heavy slab serif or rounded bubble lettering. Use this same strengthened serif for the sticker and author as well. The result should feel close to the existing cover, more confident and readable, with the main difference in the sturdiness of the finer strokes.

The main title remains enormous warm cream lettering in its established positions: "The" near the upper left of the photograph, "Vegetable" across the upper third and "Guru" below on the left. Keep the oversized V and G crossing the photograph's left edge and retain the distinctive descending G flourish, adapted coherently to the chosen family. Keep the title's overall silhouette, line arrangement and visual widths close to the reference. Preserve the space around John's face; do not let the stronger lettering cover his face.

The subtitle stays inside the existing lower-left cream circular sticker, in the SAME SERIF FAMILY as the title, dark green and sufficiently sturdy to read easily. Keep four centred lines, with balanced breathing room inside the circle:
Your
at-a-glance
growing
companion
The author remains "John Lennon" at lower right, in dark green, in the SAME SERIF FAMILY, keeping the existing position and general size.

FIXED COLOUR: The exact light sage background in the reference is already chosen by the user. Preserve that light sage hue, brightness and restrained surface finish. Do not darken it, intensify it, make it mint, olive, yellow or blue. Preserve warm cream title/sticker and dark-green supporting letters.

FIXED COMPOSITION AND PHOTO: Reproduce the rectangular photograph, its crop and offset position, generous right margin, circular sticker's position/size/shadow and all other geometry as closely as possible. Leave John's face, expression, hair, beard, clothes, hands, red tomatoes, metal colander and greenhouse foliage untouched. No photo retouching, new objects, altered pose or colour grade.

Exact words, each appearing once:
The Vegetable Guru
Your at-a-glance growing companion
John Lennon

This is a sophisticated book-cover typography trial, not a new layout. No explanatory labels, variant names, swatches, comparison panels, mockup perspective or additional text in the image.
